To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) entrepreneurship is not a function of wealth creation alone; (2) entrepreneurs should be encouraged to consider the ethical implications of their actions; and (3) entrepreneurs should be taught the virtues of prudence, justice, and temperance.
entrepreneurship is the act of endowing resources in a society with new value.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how entrepreneurs can be encouraged to act in ways that promote ethical behavior in business.
the question of what makes for good entrepreneurship.
the role of virtues and values as they relate to entrepreneurship and the creation of wealth.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
entrepreneurship is a process by which an entrepreneur, through his/her virtues, endows a resource with value.

entrepreneurship is a process by which an individual or a group of individuals, acting within a social and cultural environment, identify opportunities, create and develop a business, and manage the business in a responsible and ethical manner.

a successful entrepreneur should have the following characteristics: (1) the ability to identify and exploit opportunities; (2) a high level of tolerance for ambiguity; (3) a high level for risk taking; (4) a high level self-confidence and self-efficacy; (5) a strong need to achieve; and (6) a high level need for autonomy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the entrepreneur must be able to recognize the ethical challenges inherent in his/her business and be able to act on that recognition in order to achieve success.
the new definition of entrepreneurship proposed in this paper is based on the concept that entrepreneurship is about endowing resources with value.
entrepreneurship should be defined as the process of discovering and endowing resources with value and then transforming them into new products, services, and processes that are valued by customers.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the entrepreneurial mindset is a powerful and important force for good in the world, and that it is the entrepreneur’s values and virtues that will ultimately shape the world in which we live.
entrepreneurship should be defined in a way that is consistent with the values and virtues necessary for ethical and successful entrepreneurship.
entrepreneurship is a process of creating value for others, and that this process is guided by a set of values that are consistent with the virtues of a good society.
